Welcome to [Default Cube Games](https://defaultcubegames.com/), an indie game development studio! 

Aka Julia Holdnack, inspired by the Nancy Drew games by HeR Interactive, she branched out from her work as a graphic designer to pursue game development and 3D modeling.
